topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: It's been years since they left my classroom, and yet, here it is—an unexpected gift, wrapped in paper that's a little too bright for the day I'm having. I can still see their young face, full of questions and fears, and I remember the way they used to light up when they understood something new. Holding this gift, I'm not sure what to feel. It's a reminder of days that have passed, of the life that moves on without us. But maybe, just maybe, it's also a whisper of the good that stays, of the small marks we leave on each other’s lives. I'll keep it, of course, but the room seems a little quieter now.
